wnba.Headline: Cheryl Reeve advocates for trans athletes before Fever game
wnba.Description: Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve reiterated her support for trans athletes ahead of her team's game against the Fever, saying "every kid has a right to sports."

wnba.Headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA
wnba.Description: Sophie Cunningham said what she said about transgender women in sports. Now others want their say, whether the WNBA wants to hear them or not.

wnba.Headline: Sky's Sydney Taylor lets it 'fly,' dumps Aces with 'big' late 3-pointer
wnba.Description: Sydney Taylor became the first rookie in franchise history to hit a go-ahead 3-pointer in the final five seconds of the fourth quarter or overtime Saturday to beat the defending champion Las Vegas Aces 84-83.

wnba.Headline: Ionescu has 27 points, 10 rebounds as Liberty edge Mercury 94-92
wnba.Description: — Sabrina Ionescu had 27 points and 10 assists, Han Xu scored 17 points off the bench, and the New York Liberty edged the Phoenix Mercury 94-92 on Saturday.

wnba.Headline: Sydney Taylor's 29 points, last second 3-pointer give Sky an 84-83 win over Liberty
wnba.Description: — Sydney Taylor hit a 3-pointer with less than a second remaining and finished with 29 points as the Chicago Sky beat the Las Vegas Aces 84-83 on Saturday.

wnba.Description: Sky win 84-83 thriller over Aces

wnba.Headline: Inside Dallas Wings forward Jessica Shepard's breakout season
wnba.Description: The forward was on a contender last season but wanted a larger role. She found what she was looking for in Dallas.

wnba.Headline: Clark has 26 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists in the Fever's victory over the Fire
wnba.Description: — Caitlin Clark had 26 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists for her fourth career triple-double, and the Indiana Fever won their their fifth straight with a 112-98 victory over the Portland Fire on Friday night.

wnba.Headline: Who has the most triple-doubles in WNBA history? Key stats
wnba.Description: A triple-double is an impressive feat. Which WNBA players have achieved it? Check out a historical rundown of stat leaders.

wnba.Headline: Fever's Sophie Cunningham not concerned about being a distraction
wnba.Description: Sophie Cunningham said she is unconcerned that the rallies against transgender participation in women's sports that have accompanied the Fever's recent games are a distraction for the WNBA team.

wnba.Headline: Reese has 19th double-double of the season in the Dream's 98-89 win over the Storm
wnba.Description: — Angel Reese had 21 points and 13 rebounds for her 19th double-double of the season and the Atlanta Dream beat the Seattle Storm 98-89 on Friday night for their fifth straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Mystics beat the Wings 81-75 for 1st 4-game winning streak since 2020
wnba.Description: — Shakira Austin scored a season-high 28 points and had 10 rebounds, Kiki Iriafen added 22 points and nine rebounds and the Washington Mystics beat the Dallas Wings 81-75 on Friday night.
